description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue is crafted for daily urban navigators conquering dense traffic. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1269g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~85 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and a glove-friendly quick-release ratcheting buckle.
yoast_title: Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
introduction: Positioned in Ruroc's Full Face lineup, the Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue brings British engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 track safety.
story:
The Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue represents Ruroc's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
